England Defeats Sri Lanka in First ODI Match

England secured a significant victory against Sri Lanka in the first One Day International (ODI) match. Will Jacks was a key player in England's win. For the match, England announced its playing XI, including a chance for Rehan Ahmed, while Adil Rashid was out of the team.
